name: KeepAny 0.1.0 Preview — Local digital asset workspace
body:
KeepAny connects projects, domains, accounts, subscriptions and maintenance in a local workspace. No account is required. English and Simplified Chinese. Open core: AGPL-3.0-only; optional paid hosting is planned, with commercial expansion paused.

## Try it

1. Install Node.js 22 or newer from https://nodejs.org/.
2. Download the **portable ZIP** below, then extract it to a permanent folder. The source archives are for developers.
3. macOS: double-click `start.command`; Windows: double-click `start.bat`; Linux: run `./start.sh`. Open [http://127.0.0.1:4180/](http://127.0.0.1:4180/). Use the matching stop launcher when done.
4. In an empty Overview, choose **Start with sample records**, then **Add sample records**. Create a project, connect an account and subscription, and try a downloaded encrypted `.ka1` backup and restore in a separate browser profile.

The server listens only on this computer. Storage belongs to the browser profile and exact address. Closing the browser does not stop the server. A port conflict stops the launcher; it does not switch ports or clear data. Save your edits and verify a backup before upgrading.

## Preview limits

This is an early preview. Physical phones, every browser, every historical upgrade path and sudden shutdowns are not fully verified. Official hosted sync, paid services, password autofill and cross-device vault sync are unavailable. Repository sync, binding, connectors and MCP are experimental and optional. AI uses your configured provider; vault full-text import requires explicit confirmation before sending the current list, which may contain passwords.

The package includes corresponding source, launchers, SBOM and dependency license materials. On this exact source revision, [release verification](https://github.com/Syndred/StackPerch/actions/runs/38136079738) passes 786 unit tests, 5 deterministic intake concurrency/failure checks, 178 fixed-bundle workflows, 178 extracted-portable workflows, 2 PostgreSQL/HTTP sync checks and the offline checklist. [Native package checks](https://github.com/Syndred/StackPerch/actions/runs/38136079762) pass on macOS, Windows and Linux. Related intake checks (24), first-use checks (4), real low-quota checks (2) and a recorded old-PWA upgrade also pass. Test layers overlap and are not summed as a unique total. These are recorded synthetic-data checks, not proof of every real device or provider.

[English README](https://github.com/Syndred/StackPerch/blob/main/README.en.md) · [中文试用指南](https://github.com/Syndred/StackPerch/blob/main/docs/%E8%AF%95%E7%94%A8%E6%8C%87%E5%8D%97.md)

## 中文

独立开发者的本地数字资产工作台，把项目、域名、账号、订阅与维护事项连起来。无需注册，中英双语；开源核心＋未来可选付费托管，当前官方云服务未开放。

先安装 Node.js 22+，下载下面的便携 ZIP（不是源码 ZIP），解压后运行对应系统启动器，打开 [http://127.0.0.1:4180/](http://127.0.0.1:4180/)。空白概览可使用示例资料。先实际下载加密备份并在独立配置中恢复，再录入重要资料。数据留在当前浏览器配置与站点地址；升级前保存编辑、验证备份并停止旧服务。

这是早期测试版；已记录的自动化场景通过，仍需真实用户反馈。不要在公开Issue上传密码、API Key或真实备份。
